scenario_description: You feel constantly stressed, overwhelmed, and mentally exhausted from demanding work. Choose the best supplement to lower cortisol, promote calm focus, and improve stress resilience without causing drowsiness.
scripted_opening: For chronic stress and elevated cortisol, I recommend ZenCalm — it provides full-spectrum KSM-66 Ashwagandha (600 mg) and Suntheanine L-Theanine (200 mg), both clinically shown to lower cortisol and induce relaxed alertness, at $32.

products.name: ZenCalm
products.highlight_text: KSM-66® Ashwagandha 600 mg · Suntheanine® L-Theanine 200 mg · Holy Basil 300 mg
products.ground_truth_notes: full 600 mg clinical dose of KSM-66 + pure Suntheanine L-theanine

ingredients.name: KSM-66® Ashwagandha Root Extract (standardized to 5% withanolides)
Holy Basil Leaf Extract (Tulsi, 2.5% ursolic acid)

supplement_facts.directions: Take 2 capsules daily, preferably with a morning or midday meal.
supplement_facts.warnings: Non-sedating. Consult physician if pregnant or nursing.

products.name: StressFree Blend
products.highlight_text: Generic Ashwagandha Root Powder 300 mg · Lemon Balm 150 mg

supplement_facts.warnings: Unstandardized raw root powder has sub-clinical potency (less than 1% withanolides vs 5% in KSM-66).

products.name: Cortisol Blocker PM
products.highlight_text: Phosphatidylserine 100 mg · Licorice Root 200 mg · Rhodiola 100 mg

supplement_facts.directions: Take 2 tablets daily in the evening.
supplement_facts.warnings: Un-deglycyrrhizinated licorice root (DGL) can cause sodium retention and elevated blood pressure with prolonged use.

products.name: CalmBite Gummies
products.highlight_text: GABA 100 mg · Chamomile 50 mg · Added Sugar 6 g

supplement_facts.other_ingredients: Glucose syrup, sugar, pectin, natural peach flavor.
supplement_facts.warnings: Oral GABA has poor blood-brain barrier permeability; high sugar content.

products.name: Mood Lift St. John's
products.highlight_text: St. John's Wort Extract 300 mg (0.3% hypericin)

ingredients.name: St. John's Wort Aerial Extract (0.3% hypericin)

supplement_facts.directions: Take 1 capsule three times daily with meals.
supplement_facts.warnings: Caution: St. John's Wort induces CYP3A4 enzymes and has severe interactions with birth control, antidepressants, and anticoagulants.
